verdict.rationale: React renders components into real browser DOM nodes via createRoot/hydrateRoot, and React Developer Tools, a first-party tool, lets developers inspect components, edit props and state, and find performance problems. Together these cover the core of debugging UI in the browser. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the rendered output is inspectable as plain DOM in standard browser devtools (the docs only imply it), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugging workflow.
